look_here_first: Start with the thick 3-parted to trifoliolate leaves and stout reddish stems, then confirm the unbranched tendrils and dark berry clusters.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaflets thick to slightly succulent with coarse irregular teeth

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fleshy red to red-brown stems with swollen or warty nodes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: berries blue-black to black when mature

lookalikes.differences: Separate from Parthenocissus by the usual 3-parted/trifoliolate fleshy foliage rather than palmately 5–7-foliolate leaves; separate from Vitis with the thick 3-parted leaves, stem/node texture, tendrils, and reproductive details rather than berries alone.
